mods.name: Salvage Rubble
mods.author: Moja
mods.description:
This mod allows the deconstruction of Rubble Piles (added in RimWorld 1.6 / Odyssey) to yield a small amount of salvageable resources:

    - Steel (common)
    - Wood (rare)
    - Components (very rare)
    - Gold (ultra rare)
    - Plasteel (extremely rare)

    Internally, cost values are scaled using high integers (e.g. Steel = 1000) to allow precise tuning of returned materials via the resourcesFractionWhenDeconstructed field.

    Future versions may support Construction skill-based return scaling and configuration options.

This mod is entirely cosmetic, and is safe to add or remove mid-save.

mods.name: Ancient Ruins All Deconstructible
mods.author: Meteores
mods.description:
Have you tried living in the ruins of cities? It's not that easy to get several floors, but I personally want to. It is very difficult to rebuild everything to suit your needs in cities, because getting rid of all the junk is incredibly long and tedious, and these walls that cannot be dismantled in any honest way.

There is a solution! Ancient Urban Ruins All Deconstructible allows you to disassemble almost everything in ruins simply by ordering it to be disassembled, cleanly and without residual debris.

Currently supports:
- Ancient urban ruins
- Ancient mining industry
- Ancient hydroponic farm facilities
- The Dead Man's Switch - AncientCorps

(Maybe in the future I will give HP to the walls, but if you give it just like that, then all existing walls will have negative health, and for new ones there will be 1 HP.)

To give HP to walls and some objects, check out this mod:  
Ancient Urban Ruins Hit Point  
If you have any structures from Ancient Urban Ruins, do not install this mod, otherwise all modified objects will have negative health.

Well, just for aesthetics, I gave the sculptures in the mall a lot of beauty.

Is it safe to add to an existing game?
- Yes. This is just a small XML patch.
But I recommend always making backups 

Is it safe to delete? 
- Yes, no problem. This is just a small XML patch.

But I recommend always making backups 

Write if you find compatibility issues.

mods.name: Facial Animation Compatability Project
mods.author: DanZinagri
mods.description:
I like what Genetic Framework is doing, it seems like a really clean system, but I like the head shapes provided by NL Facial Animation, as they tend to fit the more anime aesthetic, especially as i tend to run stuff alongside races like ratkin and the like. So going to do some adjustments in an attempt to bring things more in line with that style.
	
	Currently Supported:
	- Vanilla Races Expanded - Phytokin (Specifically the Barkskin head) - No Heavy Jaw or Gaunt Yet.
    - Vanilla Heavy Jaw Gene (so Neanderthals and such)
    - Vanilla Gaunt Gene (So wasters and such)
    
    If applying to existing save/pawn, go into the facial animation menu and select the BarkSkin face, this should swap over to the new head texture; this overwrites the normal list of heads.

mods.name: SimpleStairs (Fork)
mods.author: gomi, b0unt9
mods.description:
[h1]SimpleStairs (Fork)[/h1]

This is a [b]fork[/b] of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2926310517]original "SimpleStairs" mod[/url] for RimWorld, updated to support [b]version 1.6[/b].

As of RimWorld 1.6, the [b]placingDraggableDimensions[/b] XML element used in 1.5 is no longer supported. It has been superseded by [b]drawStyleCategory[/b], which should be used to specify the visual and interaction style of placeable objects.

[hr]

[h2]📦 Differences from the Original Mod[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]placingDraggableDimensions[/b] has been replaced by [b]drawStyleCategory[/b] to control object placement and visual behavior.
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]📌 Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*]This is [b]not an official update[/b] by the original author.  
[*]This is a simple update for 1.6 compatibility.  
[*]The mod should be safe to use in existing saves, but always back up your game just in case.
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]📜 Credits[/h2]

[list]
[*]Original mod by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198109651831/]gomi[/url] ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2926310517]Workshop page[/url])  
[*]1.6 update by [url=https://github.com/b0unt9]Bounty[/url]
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]🔧 Compatibility[/h2]

[list]
[*]RimWorld 1.5, 1.6  
[*]Incompatible with the original mod (disable one or the other)
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]💬 Feedback[/h2]

Issues or suggestions?  
Feel free to leave a comment or contact me via GitHub:  
[url=https://github.com/rw-mod/SimpleStairs]github.com/rw-mod/SimpleStairs[/url]
